title: potentilla recta subsp. laciniosa
intro: Potentilla recta subsp. laciniosa, commonly known as the fragrant cinquefoil or five-fingered cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents found in Potentilla recta subsp. laciniosa include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
